the study of isospin-mixed states in nuclei and their effects on superallowed Fermi transitions.
the calculation of the isospin-mixed Fermi β-deptay matrix elements for the superallowed 0 + → 0 + transitions of 22 Mg and 34 Cl and the forbidden 0 + → (1 +, 2 +) transitions of 34 Cl.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the isospin-non–conserving corrections are small for the 34 Cl, 22 Mg, and 34 Cl decays, but that for the 34 Ar decay they are large.
the isospin-mixed corrections to the Fermi β-deay of 34 Cl are small, and that the isospins of the 0 + ground states of 34 Cl, 34 Ar, and 34 S are well defined.
the shell-model isospin-mixed matrix elements are in reasonable agreement with experiment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
isospin mixing in the 1s 0 d-shell nuclei is small.
the isospin-mixed Fermi matrix elements of 34 Cl, 34 Ar, and 22 Mg are all reduced by about 2% relative to the Fermi single-particle matrix elements.
the corrections due to isospin mixing are of comparable size to the radial-overlap corrections.
